dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Order credits, allocate them to your employees and follow their use.
dashboard.emptyMessage: Order credits to top up your balance.
dashboard.flowsTitle: Flows over the last six months
dashboard.flowsDescription: Credits added to your balance and credits allocated to your employees.
dashboard.recentDescription: Your latest credit orders and their status.
dashboard.todoPay: Order {reference}: transfer {amount}, then declare your transfer.
dashboard.todoRejected: Order {reference}: proof rejected, declare your transfer again.
dashboard.balancesDescription: One balance per type: an allocation debits the balance of the chosen type.

orders.title: Credit orders
orders.description: Each order is confirmed by FlexiPay, then you declare your transfer; credits are added once it is validated.

newOrder.title: New credit order
newOrder.description: FlexiPay confirms your order, you make and declare the transfer, then the credits are added to your balance once checked.
newOrder.amountInvalid: Invalid amount: digits and a decimal separator, 3 decimals at most.
newOrder.summaryEmpty: Enter an amount, then calculate the summary.
newOrder.confirmMessage: The order will be created. You will get the reference to use on your transfer.
newOrder.doneMessage: Make a transfer of {amount} with the reference {reference}. Credits will be available after reconciliation.
newOrder.categoryHint: A single category for now: Food.
newOrder.linesHint: Enter an amount for each type to order (leave the others empty).

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: Manage your beneficiaries and their access.
employees.name: Name
employees.emptyMessage: Add your employees one by one or import a CSV file.
employees.formDescription: A temporary password (valid for {days} days) will be sent to the employee.
employees.created: {name} has been added. A temporary password has been sent.
employees.duplicate: An employee with this number or e-mail already exists.

import.title: Import employees
import.description: CSV file: number; first name; last name; e-mail; phone (one line per employee).
import.fileHint: 1 MB maximum. The first line may hold the headers.
import.created: {count} employees were created. Each one received an invitation.
import.onlyValid: Only valid lines will be created. Fix the file for the others.

allocation.title: Allocate credits
allocation.description: Select employees and the amount to credit to each one.
allocation.selected: {count, plural, one {# employee selected} other {# employees selected}}
allocation.insufficient: Insufficient balance: {amount} is missing. Order credits or reduce the amount.
allocation.name: Name
allocation.typeHint: Only the balance of this type is debited.
allocation.relaunching: Relaunching the template “{name}”: check the preview, then allocate.
allocation.templateNotSaved: Allocation done, but the template was not saved: {reason}
allocation.stepPeopleHint: Filter by department, position or name, then tick employees or select the whole result of the filter.
allocation.stepAmountsHint: The same amount for each selected employee. Empty = 0.
allocation.previewHint: The preview shows the total per type and the balance left before you allocate.
allocation.templateNameHint: The template keeps the filters (department, position) and the amounts, not the list of people.
allocation.confirmMany: Employees credited: {count}. Only the balance of each type is debited.
allocation.previewInsufficient: Insufficient balance for at least one type: order credits or lower the amount.

reporting.title: Reporting
reporting.description: Credits received and allocated per month, and your wallet by type.
reporting.flowsDescription: Credits received from your orders and allocated to your employees.
reporting.emptyMessage: It will appear after your first order.

departments.title: Departments
departments.name: Department name
departments.duplicate: A department already has this name.
departments.emptyText: Create a first department to group your employees.

templates.title: Allocation templates
templates.description: Relaunch a saved allocation: its filters apply to the current employees.
templates.name: Name
templates.deleteMessage: The template “{name}” will no longer be offered. Allocations already made do not change.
templates.editHint: The next relaunch will use these filters and amounts.
templates.emptyHint: In Allocate, tick “Save as a template” to create one.
